column3: MT 2:3. “The belly of Sheol” is rendered “the depth of Sheol”; NASB adds “And.”
MT 2:4. “You have thrown” is rendered “You had cast,” and “a river surrounds me” “the current engulfed me”; NASB adds “For” and “Into.”
MT 2:5. “Driven away from before your eyes” is rendered “expelled from Your sight”; NASB adds “So.”
MT 2:6. “To the neck” (or “soul”) is rendered “to the point of death,” and “rushes” “Weeds.”
MT 2:7. “Extremities” is rendered “roots”; “the earth, its bars were behind me” is rendered “The earth with its bars was around me.”
MT 2:8. “When my life fainted away on me” is rendered “While I was fainting away”; NASB adds “Into.”
MT 2:9. “Vanities of nothingness” is rendered “vain idols,” and “loyalty” “faithfulness.”
MT 2:10. “Rescue belongs to the LORD” is rendered “Salvation is from the LORD”; “fulfill” is rendered “pay.”
